title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
snippet: PNOĒ, the Malden, Mass.-based startup whose breath-analyzing mask used to bear an unfortunate resemblance to Bane's, is launching a sleeker self-serve version on October 1 that lets gym-goers measure their VO₂ max and other metabolic markers in eight minutes without a trained operator.

title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
snippet: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.

title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
snippet: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.
